q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution
The Q2 FY2027 earnings release is scheduled for August 26, 2026 (in 2 days from today, August 24, 2026). This is an extremely short timeframe—the guidance will be announced imminently.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The question asks for **forward guidance** issued during the Q2 FY2027 earnings release on August 26, 2026. This is guidance for the *next* quarter (Q3 FY2027).

Based on the research provided:
- NVIDIA issued guidance on May 20, 2026 for Q2 FY2027 at $91.0B ± 2% ($89.2B–$92.8B)
- Actual Q2 FY2027 revenue is expected to come in around the guided range (analyst consensus: $91.9B)
- Q1 FY2027 actual was $81.6B
- Recent sequential growth has been 20% (Q1) and ~11% projected (Q2)

When companies report Q2 results on August 26, they will simultaneously issue forward guidance for Q3 FY2027.

**Historical pattern**: NVIDIA typically guides with ±2% ranges around their midpoint estimates. Sequential growth guidance has moderated from 20% to ~11%. However, the AI demand cycle remains strong, and NVIDIA has been conservative in recent guidance (actual results tend to meet or exceed midpoint).

Given:
- Q2 FY2027 expected to land near $91.0B
- Moderated sequential growth trajectory (from 20% to 11%)
- Strong but not accelerating demand environment
- The China headwind already priced into current guidance

A reasonable projection for Q3 FY2027 forward guidance would assume continued sequential growth of **8–12%** from the ~$91B Q2 level, suggesting a midpoint around **$101–$102B**.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- **Deteriorating demand signals**: If actual Q2 results miss significantly or management provides negative color on demand
- **Macro slowdown**: Economic weakness or hyperscaler capex reductions
- **Geopolitical escalation**: Stricter China restrictions or broader export controls
- **Competitive pressures**: Unexpected gains by AMD, Intel, or custom solutions
- **Conservative resets**: Management choosing to underpromise to ensure beats
- Sequential growth deceleration to 5–7% would yield ~$95–97B guidance

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- **Better-than-expected Q2 results**: Beating the $91B midpoint would raise the baseline
- **Accelerating demand signals**: Evidence of renewed hyperscaler capex or enterprise adoption
- **China policy clarity**: Any easing of restrictions could unlock significant upside
- **Product momentum**: Strong H100/H200/B100 demand pulling forward orders
- **Margin expansion confidence**: Higher pricing power or utilization rates
- Sequential growth sustaining 12–15% would yield ~$102–105B guidance

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- Q1 FY2027 sequential growth: 20%
- Q2 FY2027 guidance implies ~11% sequential growth
- NVIDIA's historical guidance has used ±2% ranges
- Analyst consensus for Q2: $91.9B (within the $89.2–$92.8B guided range)

The deceleration from 20% to 11% sequential growth represents a clear trend. The question is whether this moderation continues, flattens, or reverses.

---

## Reasoning for Point Estimates

**Most likely scenario**: Q2 actual comes in near $91.0–$92.0B, and forward guidance for Q3 assumes ~10% sequential growth, resulting in a **midpoint of ~$101–$102B** with a ±2% range.

The range provided (99.5–115.5B) is quite wide, allowing for significant uncertainty. My distribution:
- **10th percentile (downside)**: Assume 7% sequential growth from $91B = ~$97.4B, but guidance midpoint would be slightly higher after Q2 results = **~99.5B** (at lower bound)
- **50th percentile (median)**: Assume 10–11% sequential growth from ~$91.5B actual = **~101.5–102.0B**
- **90th percentile (upside)**: Assume 13–14% sequential growth from $92B = **~104.0–105.0B**

Given the range and the uncertainty in where Q2 actually lands plus guidance philosophy, I'm centering the median around **101.5–102.0B** with reasonable downside to ~99.5B and upside to ~105B.

Low (10th percentile): 99500000000
Median (50th percentile): 101500000000
High (90th percentile): 104500000000
q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is scheduled to release its Q2 FY2027 earnings report on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, after market close [morningstar.com](https://www.morningstar.com/stocks/going-into-earnings-is-nvidia-stock-buy-sell-or-fairly-valued-8).

For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA's own guidance, issued on May 20, 2026, projected revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). This implies a range from approximately $89.2 billion to $92.8 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). This guidance assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

Analysts compiled by Yahoo! Finance have an average estimate for Q2 FY2027 revenue at $91.9 billion, which falls within NVIDIA's guided range [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). In its Q1 FY2027 earnings, NVIDIA reported record revenue of $81.6 billion, an 85% increase year-over-year and a 20% increase from the previous quarter [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). The Q2 FY2027 guidance implies an approximately 11% sequential revenue growth, a slowdown from the 20% sequential growth in Q1 [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).
